overview: The Void Resonance Basin is the epicenter of void bleed-through in the Umbral Plains. Resonance pools, void pockets, and planar fractures converge here.
history: The Basin formed when the largest planar fracture on Luclin opened centuries ago.
Void resonance pooled into the depression, creating unstable planar pockets.
Voidborn entities emerged from resonance pools, hostile to all mortal forces.
Akhevan Dominion ritualists established ascension pylons to harness the Basin’s power.
Umbral Vanguard containment attempts repeatedly failed due to storm intensity.
hooks: A resonance pool destabilizes, threatening a planar collapse.
Voidborn swarms emerge from a newly opened void pocket.
Akhevan ascendants attempt a mass siphon ritual.
A mega-storm forms above the Basin, altering all zone hazards.
